why_best: This unified reveal-and-clamp behavior endows abstract corporate telemetry with tangible weight, visually cementing product specs onto the physical silhouette.
why_bad: Allowing the callout to simply fade in place or float at a distance severs the relationship between the hardware and its specs, reducing a high-impact product claim to a disconnected overlay.
trap: Failing to pull the typography tight against the subject's border leaves an awkward dead channel that destroys the illusion of an integrated tool.
